'''Synedian algae''' was a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that was cultivated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Syned]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. The [[Nerve toxin/Legends|nerve toxin]] [[Chagras's Blood]] was created from Synedian [[Algae/Legends|algae]].
